_comment: Copy to config.json. Nothing here is required to read data: no skill needs an API key, a token or an account.
_capital: Your trading capital in rupees. nse-risk sizes positions against this.
_risk: How much of capital you accept losing on one trade. 1 percent is a common starting point. nse-risk blocks anything above this.
_max_positions: How many open positions at once before nse-risk refuses a new one.
_upstox: Entirely optional, and nothing needs it. Its only use is nse-results --cross-check, which compares the accounts against a second source. Free at upstox.com/developer.
